description: Sends a trigger when a chosen keyboard key is pressed, 3HP; the mouse cursor must be over the module for the key to register

params.text: Press it, then press a key to store that key, with any modifiers held, as the hotkey. The light shows red until the key is taken
Holds the trigger back after the key is pressed, 0 to 1 second

outputs.text: A 10V pulse lasting 2ms each time the hotkey is pressed

notes: the stored key starts as the space bar, and the module's menu prints the key in use under the heading Current hotkey
menu: Treat modifiers as key hits — allows shift, control, alt or the command key to be stored as the hotkey in its own right
